payload.reason: The evidence clearly defines the source and target domains in the context of domain adaptation and sentiment classification.

claims.text: The source domain is the existing domain with sufficient labeled data, while the target domain is the new domain with few or no labeled data.
In cross-domain sentiment classification, knowledge is transferred from the source domain to the target domain to reduce labeling effort.
The classifier is trained on the source domain and evaluated on the target domain, indicating their distinct roles in the adaptation process.
